description: Check whether a TCP port is open on a host, with quick buttons for common ports and measured response time.

faqs.a: 80 (HTTP), 443 (HTTPS), 21 (FTP), 22 (SSH), 25 (SMTP), 3306 (MySQL) and 8080 (alt HTTP) — or type any port from 1 to 65535.
A closed result means our server could not connect. Your own firewall, ISP filtering, or the target's firewall can all affect the result.
No. The check is performed from our server, so your local firewall does not affect it — but it also cannot see ports blocked only on your network.
faqs.q: Is the check done from my computer?

howto: Type a hostname such as example.com.
Enter a port number or tap a quick-port button.
See the Open/Closed result and the response time in milliseconds.
title: Port Checker
